wanted: Write a Node.js program extract.js that parses /app/a.out (an ELF binary) and outputs a JSON object mapping memory addresses to integer values matching the reference solution.
why_couldnt: The agent hit the maximum number of episodes (21 turns) without returning, spending all its turns exploring the ELF binary using readelf, objdump, and python scripts without successfully implementing or running the required extract.js program.

evidence.quote: AssertionError: Only found 0.00% of expected values (required: 75%)

workaround_seen: The agent experimented with various python scripts and readelf/objdump commands to inspect sections of the ELF binary, but failed to produce the final Node.js implementation within the turn limit.
